The ground truth of this sector

Operators see BI & Analytics Platform as one more decision surface with one difference: every recommendation carries its evidence, and every override is logged with a reason. The rollout order differs by industry; the operator experience does not — fewer surprises, faster answers, and a trail that makes the post-incident review short.
A value assessment prices the delta in your estate before anything is signed: a working session on BI & Analytics Platform, measured against your baseline, in two weeks.
